title: Templates: lerp and interpolateAt
hints: lerp only needs `T - T`, `T * double` and `T + T`: `a + (b - a) * t` works for double and Eigen vectors. Return a `T` so Eigen expressions get evaluated.
Clamp first: t <= samples.front().first -> front value, t >= samples.back().first -> back value.
`std::lower_bound(begin, end, t, [](const auto& s, double t) { return s.first < t; })` gives the first sample with time >= t. The bracketing pair is (it-1, it).
